article.story: COLUMBIA, S.C. -- — Jakub Necas scored 13 of his 24 points in the first half, and South Carolina built a 21-point halftime lead and then held off Elon for an 80-72 victory on Wednesday night. Necas shot 7 of 9 from the floor, made 9 of 11 free-throw attempts and grabbed eight of the Gamecocks' 36 rebounds. Juan Fernandez added 15 points for South Carolina (5-0). Camden Heide scored 12 points and Marcus Johnson had 10. The Gamecocks had their largest lead, 68-44 with 13:17 remaining. Elon answered with a 26-9 run to pull to 76-70 with 2:07 left. Randall Pettus II hit a 3-pointer and scored 11 points during the stretch, but the Phoenix missed their last three field-goal attempts. Pettus finished with 20 points on 8-of-13 shooting to lead Elon (2-3). Cam Thrower added 10 points. South Carolina took the lead for good with about 14 minutes left in the first half and led 58-37 at the break. Fernandez paced the Gamecocks with 14 points in the first half. Up next Elon: Hosts Morehead State on Saturday. South Carolina: The Gamecocks travel for the first time this season to face No. 18 Southern California on Wednesday in the Acrisure Series. ------ Sign up for Top 25 poll alerts here, visit the Top 25 here and see AP’s full men’s basketball coverage here
